jobs.description:
About the role

We are looking for a senior leader to provide strategy expertise in support of Vanguard’s mission, clients, products and crew. As Senior Director Strategy & Offer, Personal Wealth, you will be a critical leader helping to shape the strategy and offers for Personal Wealth.

Personal Wealth is Vanguard’s unified division focused on delivering exceptional experiences for individual investors across every stage of their financial journey. Organized around distinct client segments, the division brings together the strengths of Vanguard’s Personal Investor and Wealth Management models to provide focused advice, innovative solutions, and scalable personalization.

Through segment-specific distribution, specialized advice and wealth capabilities, and a strong emphasis on digital and client experience transformation, Personal Wealth is designed to meet evolving client needs with both human insight and advanced technology. Our teams work collaboratively to simplify how we operate, accelerate execution, and deliver industry-leading outcomes for millions of investors.

This is a high-visibility role that will materially shape Personal Wealth’s strategy as we build it out this year and beyond — with direct exposure to Personal Wealth leadership and across the broader organization.

- Lead or contribute to enterprise initiatives and special projects as needed

- Build, lead, and develop high-performing teams; set clear performance expectations, provide coaching, and make compensation decisions in alignment with company policy

Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required; Master’s degree preferred

- 8+ years of experience in corporate strategy, management consulting, or financial analysis, ideally with a top-tier consulting firm

- Demonstrated strategic judgment in highly ambiguous environments, with strength in framing complex problems and driving sound executive decisions

- Proven ability to independently lead large-scale, high-impact strategic initiatives from concept through execution

- Executive presence with the ability to influence without authority — crafting clear strategic narratives, aligning senior stakeholders, and driving outcomes

- Strong people and talent leadership, with accountability for building, developing, and sustaining high-performing teams

jobs.title: Active Municipal Investment Analyst
jobs.description:
Vanguard is seeking an Active Municipal Investment Analyst to join its Municipal Fixed Income Research team. This position offers the opportunity to develop municipal credit research and investment expertise through a collaborative apprenticeship model, working alongside experienced investors at the largest institutional municipal fixed income investment manager.

Supporting senior analysts, the Investment Analyst will conduct fundamental credit research, evaluate investment opportunities, and translate issuer-level analysis into clear credit opinions, relative value assessments, and actionable investment insights across investment-grade and high-yield municipal credits. The analyst will collaborate closely with portfolio managers and traders to develop and implement investment strategies.

The successful candidate will bring intellectual curiosity, sound analytical judgment, an interest in financial markets, and the ability to form and communicate investment views in an evolving market environment.

In this role, you will

- Conduct fundamental credit research on municipal issuers across assigned sectors, regions, and areas of coverage.
- Support senior analysts in evaluating credits, maintaining issuer coverage, and developing investment perspectives.
- Develop and contribute to internal credit ratings, credit outlooks, investment theses, relative value assessments, and investment strategy recommendations.
- Translate research findings into timely, actionable insights for senior analysts, portfolio managers, traders, and other investment stakeholders.
- Present credit opinions, research findings, and investment views in team discussions, portfolio reviews, and other investment forums.

- Analyze audited financial statements, budgets, operating performance, revenue trends, debt profiles, capital plans, liquidity, leverage, debt-service coverage, pension obligations, and other long-term liabilities.

- Build and maintain financial models, bond payment schedules, scenario analyses, and stress tests to evaluate the relationship between operating performance and credit quality.

- Respond to research and fixed income desk inquiries and provide analysis supporting portfolio and investment decisions.
- Monitor economic, demographic, political, regulatory, and public-policy developments that may affect individual issuers or municipal sectors.
- Contribute to special projects and initiatives that enhance the team’s research capabilities, analytical tools, data quality, and investment processes.

We recognize that strong candidates can bring different combinations of experience and skills, and we encourage applicants who are excited about the role and interested in developing as investors to apply.

Qualifications
Required

- Experience in financial services, public finance, investment research, or another analytical field that demonstrates transferable skills.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present analytical findings and views clearly.
- Ability to work collaboratively with senior analysts, portfolio managers, traders, and other investment professionals.
- Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and commitment to maintaining accurate, high-quality research and financial data.

Preferred

- Experience or exposure to investment management, financial markets, public finance, or related fields.
- Interest in or progress toward the Chartered Financial Analyst designation or other relevant financial certification.
- Exposure to Python, R, or comparable analytical and data-development tools.

What Will Help You Succeed

- A curious and independent mindset, balanced with the ability to contribute effectively within a collaborative, team-based investment process.
